newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINES REOPENS T-BILL TAP FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINES REOPENS T-BILL TAP FACILITY.

text.p: The Philippine Bureau of Treasury has re-opened its tap facility to sell Treasury bills to accredited dealers at the lowest accepted rates in Monday's auction, National Treasurer Caridad Valdehuesa said.
She said the Treasury would sell an additional one billion pesos each for the three maturities.
The 91-day bills will be sold at 13.5 percent, 182-day bills at 13.625 percent and one-year bills at 13.7 percent.
The offered rates were lower than the corresponding central bank's reverse repo rates.
The tap facility was closed down in November 1995 after the auctions were all fully subscribed.
T-bill auctions have been undersubscribed in recent weeks due to uncertainties in the foreign exchange market.
